/*+
NestLoop(movie_info1 info_type1)
NestLoop(title1 movie_info1 info_type1)
NestLoop(title1 movie_info1 info_type1 kind_type1)
NestLoop(title1 movie_info1 info_type1 kind_type1 cast_info1)
NestLoop(title1 movie_info1 info_type1 kind_type1 name1 cast_info1)
HashJoin(title1 movie_info1 info_type1 kind_type1 name1 cast_info1 role_type1)
*/
SELECT
  name1.name,
  movie_info1.info,
  MIN(title1.production_year),
  MAX(title1.production_year)
FROM (((((movie_info AS movie_info1 CROSS JOIN info_type AS info_type1) CROSS JOIN title AS title1) CROSS JOIN kind_type AS kind_type1) CROSS JOIN cast_info AS cast_info1) CROSS JOIN name AS name1) CROSS JOIN role_type AS role_type1
WHERE
  title1.id = cast_info1.movie_id
  AND title1.id = movie_info1.movie_id
  AND movie_info1.info_type_id = info_type1.id
  AND title1.kind_id = kind_type1.id
  AND cast_info1.person_id = name1.id
  AND cast_info1.movie_id = movie_info1.movie_id
  AND cast_info1.role_id = role_type1.id
  AND (
    info_type1.id IN ('2', '3', '6')
  )
  AND (
    movie_info1.info IN ('3 Channel Stereo', '6-Track Stereo', '70 mm 6-Track', 'Biography', 'DTS 70 mm', 'Dolby Atmos', 'Dolby SR', 'Dolby Stereo', 'Film-Noir', 'History', 'Perspecta Stereo', 'Reality-TV', 'Sonics-DDP', 'Talk-Show', 'War')
  )
  AND (
    name1.name ILIKE '%har%'
  )
  AND (
    kind_type1.kind IN ('episode', 'movie', 'video movie')
  )
  AND (
    role_type1.role IN ('actress', 'costume designer', 'director', 'miscellaneous crew', 'producer')
  )
GROUP BY
  movie_info1.info,
  name1.name

WHERE
  title1.id = movie_companies1.movie_id
  AND title1.id = cast_info1.movie_id
  AND title1.id = movie_info1.movie_id
  AND movie_info1.movie_id = cast_info1.movie_id
  AND cast_info1.movie_id = movie_companies1.movie_id
  AND company_name1.id = movie_companies1.company_id
  AND company_type1.id = movie_companies1.company_type_id
  AND kind_type1.id = title1.kind_id
  AND cast_info1.person_id = name1.id
  AND cast_info1.role_id = role_type1.id
  AND movie_info1.info_type_id = info_type1.id
  AND (
    kind_type1.kind ILIKE '%m%'
  )
  AND (
    role_type1.role IN ('actress', 'cinematographer', 'costume designer', 'director', 'editor', 'guest', 'miscellaneous crew', 'producer', 'production designer', 'writer')
  )
  AND (
    title1.production_year <= 2015
  )
  AND (
    title1.production_year >= 1875
  )
  AND (
    info_type1.id IN ('6')
  )
  AND (
    movie_info1.info ILIKE '%mo%'
  )
  AND (
    company_name1.name ILIKE '%ve%'
  )
GROUP BY
  name1.gender,
  role_type1.role,
  company_name1.name
ORDER BY
  COUNT(*) DESC NULLS FIRST
